ICS 79.060.10; 55.160CED 09Reaffirmed 20181. ScopeThis standard (Part 2) covers materials, dimensions, manufacture and requirements for plywood for use in the manufacture of tea-chests.2. ReferencesThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards aresubject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed in Annex A.
